mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friendships (user_id_1, user_id_2) VALUES (LEAST(#{userId1}, #{userId2}), GREATEST(#{userId1}, #{userId2}))
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.user_name FROM friendships f JOIN m_user u ON f.user_id_2 = u.id WHERE f.user_id_1 = #{userId} AND u.is_frozen IS FALSE UNION SELECT u.id, u.user_name FROM friendships f JOIN m_user u ON f.user_id_1 = u.id WHERE f.user_id_2 = #{userId} AND u.is_frozen IS FALSE
